class RepoLevelCodeCompletionTab(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent)

        layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout()

        # Add inputs for repository name, current files, and target filename
        self.repo_name_input = QtWidgets.QLineEdit()
        self.repo_name_input.setPlaceholderText("Repository Name")
        self.repo_name_input.textChanged.connect(self.on_repo_name_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.repo_name_input)

        self.current_files_input = QtWidgets.QListWidget()
        layout.addWidget(self.current_files_input)

        # Add a directory selector
        self.directory_button = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Select Directory")
        self.directory_button.clicked.connect(self.on_directory_selected)
        layout.addWidget(self.directory_button)

        # Use a QLineEdit for the target filename input instead
        self.target_file_input = QtWidgets.QLineEdit()
        self.target_file_input.setPlaceholderText("Target Filename")
        self.target_file_input.textChanged.connect(self.on_target_file_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.target_file_input)

        self.setLayout(layout)

        self.assistant = Assistant()

    @pyqtSlot()
    def on_directory_selected(self):
        directory = QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Directory")
        if directory:
            # Update current files list with files from the selected directory
            self.current_files_input.clear()
            for file in os.listdir(directory):
                self.current_files_input.addItem(file)

        # Handle changes to the repository name
        pass

    @pyqtSlot(str)
    def on_target_file_changed(self, target_file):
        # Handle changes to the target file name
        pass

    def process_data(self):
        repo_name = self.repo_name_input.text()
        target_file = self.target_file_input.text()
        current_files = [self.current_files_input.item(i).text() for i in range(self.current_files_input.count())]

        # Use the assistant to process the data
        message = Message(repo_name=repo_name, current_files=current_files, target_file=target_file)
        response = self.assistant.process_message(message)

        # Display the response in a QWebEngineView or handle it as needed
        web_view = QWebEngineView()
        web_view.setHtml(markdown(response))
        web_view.show()

        layout.addWidget(target_file_label)
        layout.addWidget(self.target_file_input)

        # Completion Button
        self.complete_button = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Complete Code")
        self.complete_button.clicked.connect(self.process_data)
        layout.addWidget(self.complete_button)

        # Result Display
        self.result_display = QtWidgets.QTextEdit()
        self.result_display.setReadOnly(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.result_display)

    @pyqtSlot(str)

        # Handle changes to the target file name

        repo_name = self.repo_name_input.text()
        target_file = self.target_file_input.text()
        current_files = [self.current_files_input.item(i).text() for i in range(self.current_files_input.count())]
